QuestInfo.name: Are You Sure You Can Leave?
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, #p1101002# wants to tell me something...
QuestInfo.1: #p1101002# told me I may be a knight, but I still have a long way to go before he can send me out on assignments, and asked me to train more.
QuestInfo.2: #p1101002# says although you've become a knight, you still seem to lack skills in his eyes. He isn't confident enough to send you on a mission, and asks that you train even further. You'll find #p1102000#, the training instructor at the #bEntrance to the Drill Hall#k, at the end of the Training Forest.
